artworks.title: Storm (Un orage)
artworks.medium: drypoint and (etching?) on light green paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a body of water, vegetation near the water's edge, cloudy skies, and distant land. The brushstrokes create a textured effect, with a monochromatic color scheme of varying shades of gray.

artworks.title: Willows (Les saules)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a close, slightly elevated view of trees and landscape. The horizon is low in the composition, with the land sloping away. The artwork features precise lines and strokes creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and beige. Trees are detailed with branches and trunks close to the viewer, with a faint outline of a distant landscape and sky beyond.

artworks.title: Hill with Bushes (La butte aux brousailles)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective, looking across a rugged terrain. Two tall trees stand to the right, with textured trunks. The ground is undulating with marked lines indicating movement. The horizon is subtly visible with delicate lines. The artwork features fine engravings blending with bold strokes, creating a sketch-like quality. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black against a pale background, accentuating the intricate line work.

artworks.title: Chickweed Merchant (Marchand de mouron)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a crouched position holding stems or branches with a basket on their back. The person has a beard and a cap, wears loose, tattered clothing, and is barefoot. The background is minimalistic with rough lines indicating the ground. A signature is visible in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Banks of the Saint-Pre (Rive du Saint-Pre)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with tall trees and vegetation. The brushstrokes are intricate, with fine cross-hatching creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic in earthy sepia tones. The composition includes a small water body or marsh with dense growth of trees and bushes extending into the distance.

artworks.title: Banks of the Saint-Pre (Rive du Saint-Pre)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image depicts tall trees from an eye-level perspective, with the horizon subtly suggested by the landscape's elevation. The illustration shows intricate etching techniques, with various line patterns creating texture and depth, especially in the depiction of leaves and foliage. The color palette is monochrome, using grays and blacks to convey contrast and depth. The background is softly blurred, suggesting a serene grove extending into the distance.

artworks.title: Edge of a Wood (Lisiere de bois)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a view from within a densely wooded area looking towards an opening in the distance. The horizon is high, marked by the light sky seen through the dense foliage, forming a natural archway effect with trees on each side. The etching technique includes intricate cross-hatching visible in the texture of the leaves and tree trunks. The color palette is monochromatic, using various shades of black and grey to accentuate the contrast between the dark trees and light sky. The composition narrows from the dark, textured foreground to a lighter area in the middle, opening up to a brighter expanse in the distance.

artworks.title: Banks of the Venelle (Bord de la Venelle)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view across a river towards hills covered in trees. The horizon is high, blending into the sky above the foliage. The artwork is an etching with fine lines depicting textures such as water, banks, and trees. There is a figure by the riverbank. The color palette is monochromatic with soft grays. The composition uses shading and open spaces to emphasize the natural setting.

artworks.title: Fagot-cutter (Le coupeur de fagots)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is an image of a person using a sickle to harvest. The person is leaning forward, focusing on cutting something from a low surface. They are wearing a hat and simple clothing appropriate for manual labor. The drawing uses strong lines and hatching for texture and depth, especially on the clothing and body. The background includes a tree trunk and some vague landscape details, indicating a rural setting.

artworks.title: Stand of Trees (Bouquet d'arbres)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a viewpoint slightly elevated, overlooking a gently sloping terrain. The horizon is high in the composition, filled with trees. A farmhouse and a rounded structure are present on the left side in the distance. The etching style uses linear brushstrokes to depict foliage and structures with texture and form. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and sepia creating contrast and shadow to define shapes and depth.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Girl (Tete de jeune fille)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched profile of a person's head and part of their neck. The person is in a side view position, turned to the right, with closed eyes and defined features. The hair is medium length, slightly wavy or tousled, framing the face and tapering off toward the neck. The sketch does not include specific details of clothing or surrounding objects, only focusing on the subject's face and hair. The background is plain and unadorned, with a simple, textured surface. The signature "A. Legros" is visible in the lower right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Small Hill (Le coteau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape sketch showcasing a gently rolling hill slightly off-center. The point of view is slightly elevated, showing the terrain with a gentle slope upwards. Sparse vegetation is visible on the hill and close to us, characterized by quick, light brushstrokes. These strokes vary in density, creating a sense of depth. The composition is rendered in a monochromatic palette of beige and black.

artworks.title: Path through the Woods (Sentier sous bois)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a densely wooded area with an elevated perspective, focusing on trees, branches, and foliage. The trees have thick bark and interlaced branches with dark lines suggesting movement. The style is vigorous and crosshatched, creating depth and vibrancy. The color scheme is monochrome, predominantly black and dark gray against a light background.

artworks.title: Antique Dealer B...
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of the profile view of an older person's head. Only the head and part of the neck are visible. The person is facing right, with distinct facial features including a prominent nose and deep-set eyes. They have short hair covered by a head covering or scarf, a pronounced chin, and wrinkles indicating age. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain with a gradient shading pattern emphasizing the facial profile. The artwork has an unfinished, sketch-like quality with crosshatched lines for texture and depth.

artworks.title: English Peasant (Paysan anglais)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a person's head and part of their upper torso shown in profile, facing to the right. The person has a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, high cheekbones, a long full beard, and shoulder-length wavy hair. The clothing is minimally detailed, with no specific objects visible. The background is plain with subtle shading.

artworks.title: Remembrance of My Village (Souvenir de mon village)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with trees viewed from an elevated perspective. The terrain is filled with dense clusters of trees, set against a sky. Fine lines and cross-hatching create play of light and shadow among the trees and landscape. The artwork uses a monochromatic color palette of blacks, grays, and a light background. Distant trees blend into a darker silhouette, while closer vegetation is more defined but still shadowed.

artworks.title: Corner of a Path (Au coin d'un chemin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a large tree slanting diagonally across the composition. The horizon is obscured by the tree trunk and foliage. The etching shows a dense, textured appearance for the tree bark and leaves, contrasting with sparse marks in the landscape. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray on a light background. Some subtle markings suggest foliage in the distance.

artworks.title: Meditation (La meditation)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a detailed drawing of a man's upper body. The man is positioned to the left with his face partially turned in profile. He has a bald head, a pronounced nose, a bushy mustache, and a thick beard. He is wearing a textured garment, possibly a loose robe or coat, draping around his shoulders. The man rests his head on his right hand with his elbow on a surface, possibly a table. The background is filled with intricate cross-hatching, creating a dark, textured ambiance. The image is signed by the artist, A. Legros, at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Along the Marne (Sur la Marne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with trees and thick vegetation. A tall tree is prominent on the left side. The horizon is subtle, created by the transition from foliage to the open sky. The landscape slopes gently upwards towards the center and right. The etching technique uses crosshatched lines for texture. The monochromatic palette includes shades of sepia or black and white, giving an antique feel. The lines represent underbrush and ground detail in the foreground, while trees in the distance are less detailed.

artworks.title: View of a Farm (La ferme de Valoux)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, bushes, and a sky. A group of tall, leafless trees is close to us, with detailed branches. The land undulates, leading to a rise in the terrain. The horizon is low, partially obscured by the landscape, with a hill silhouette visible. The image uses an etching technique with cross-hatched lines for texture. The color palette is mainly shades of brown and sepia. The detailed lines and limited palette create a contemplative visual impact, emphasizing the patterns in the scenery.

artworks.title: Rope-yards (Les corderies)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a slightly elevated perspective, capturing a wide expanse of terrain. The horizon line is low in the composition, where the land meets the sky. A line of trees is silhouetted across the horizon. The artist uses intricate line work, creating movement with flowing, curvilinear strokes. The sky features long, wavy lines stretching diagonally upward, adding a dynamic visual texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of brown and tan tones, giving the scene a sepia-like appearance. Closest to us are shapes resembling large thatched roofs or structures, while beyond, lighter lines portray indistinct landforms and sparse foliage. The scene conveys movement through sweeping lines, suggesting rustling wind.

artworks.title: The Old Race-grounds at Montrouge (Les vielles carriers de Montrouge)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with tall, thin structures resembling trees rising from a dense thicket. The horizon is low, dominated by the dark figures stretching towards a vast sky. The illustration uses cross-hatched brushstrokes for texture, emphasizing details of the terrain and vegetation. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black and white.

artworks.title: In the Forest of Conteville  (Dans la foret de Conteville)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image features a dense wooded area with large, intricately detailed trees dominating the scene. The horizon is obscured by the tightly clustered foliage and trunks. The etched lines emphasize the texture of the bark and leaves. The style is reminiscent of classical prints with a monochromatic color palette of black and white. In the distance, lighter etched lines suggest a clearing.

artworks.title: Old Village (Ville vieille)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated viewpoint, featuring trees spread across the terrain. The horizon is obscured by trees and possibly distant hills or structures. The etching has fluid and sketch-like lines, including vertical and diagonal brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic, with gray and black shades, creating depth. The scene includes detailed trees in the foreground and a more subdued pattern in the background.
